legal_transitions.commercial_version: Engine reserves monotonic positive candidates; abandoned candidates never reused; committed pointer may jump 4 to 7.
legal_transitions.grant: Engine append-only, FK committed version, unique order/generation; initial spawn and settled post-spawn resume only in current normative baseline. S5-01 adds replacement continuation. Never UPDATE/DELETE or reset spawn.
legal_transitions.receiver_ledger_note: Same-generation close never reopens. Resume uses successor authority. Close-before-open installs tombstones. Settled requires applicable create/intent/effect reconciliation, not a timeout.
legal_transitions.control_note: Operational statuses only. Engine creates immutable intent and pending pointer; fenced recovery may update progress. Finalization reauthorizes and checks current version/owner/barrier. Outage stays pending; abandonment never removes receiver fences.
legal_transitions.execution: Stable execution survives key-response retention; lease takeover increments owner fence. Every progress/final write checks execution identity and current owner fence.
legal_transitions.audit: Committed chain advances only under aggregate lock. Refused request stores observed committed sequence in structured evidence, never increments business chain.
legal_transitions.event: Producer preserves event_id through replay; consumer durably completes atomically with effect or after idempotent event_id effect.
